item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00063","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C12","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.9,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied the child’s overall drafting frame: identify an urgent workforce problem involving wasted resources, direct every department and agency head to take all necessary action, assign central officials to assist agencies in developing or carrying out programs, and require progress reporting to the President. C12 is a strong substantive source because it establishes the Federal Safety Council and assigns the Secretary of Labor responsibility for effective federal safety programs, but its executive-order structure is less similar to the child’s memorandum. C02 shares the assistance-and-periodic-reporting mechanism, but less of the complete sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The suffering and the wastage of both human and financial resources caused by accidents in the Government service constitute an urgent challenge.","parent_excerpt":"The present emergency has caused great demands on the manpower resources of our country, with shortages of manpower in certain special areas already being felt.","explanation":"Both open by presenting a government-workforce problem as urgent and consequential for national resources."},{"child_excerpt":"I am, therefore, requesting the head of each Government department and agency to review the accident experiences and the safety program of his organization and to take all necessary steps to reduce accidents.","parent_excerpt":"Therefore, I expect the head of each executive department and agency to take all necessary actions to conserve manpower and generally to bring about maximum effectiveness and economy in the utilization of personnel.","explanation":"This is a close operative template: each agency head is instructed to take all necessary action toward a government-wide personnel objective."},{"child_excerpt":"I have also asked him to provide or arrange for assistance to all departments and agencies in the development, organization, and maintenance of effective accident prevention programs and to report to me from time to time on the progress made.","parent_excerpt":"In order to assist the departments and agencies in achieving the results I desire, I want you, together with the Chairman of the Civil Service Commission, to issue instructions ... and to advise and consult with the departments and agencies ... so that reports can be made to me on progress in conserving manpower.","explanation":"Both centralize technical assistance and oversight in designated officials and couple that assistance with reports to the President on agency progress."}]}
